definitions.name: Petit theft of the first degree

en.plainSummary: Stealing property valued at less than $40 from a dwelling or from the unenclosed curtilage of a dwelling.
en.degreeContext: First-degree misdemeanor. A person who commits this under-$40 dwelling or curtilage offense after any prior theft conviction commits a third-degree felony; paragraph (2)(e) also states the third-degree-felony grade for two or more prior theft convictions. Property valued at $40 or more taken from a dwelling or its unenclosed curtilage is instead subject to the special grand-theft rules in paragraph (2)(d). For a second or later conviction for petit theft from a merchant, farmer or transit agency, §812.015(2) requires a $50–$1,000 fine or court-designated public service in its place. A first-degree misdemeanor ordinarily carries up to 1 year in jail and a $1,000 fine. A third-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 5 years in prison and a $5,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A first-degree misdemeanor then becomes a third-degree felony (ordinary maximum 5 years and $5,000). A third-degree felony then becomes a second-degree felony (ordinarily 15 years and $10,000 maximum).

es.plainSummary: Hurtar propiedad valorada en menos de $40 de una vivienda o del terreno residencial no cercado que la rodea.
es.degreeContext: Delito menor de primer grado. Quien comete este hurto de menos de $40 en una vivienda o su terreno circundante después de cualquier condena anterior por hurto comete delito grave de tercer grado; el párrafo (2)(e) también establece ese grado grave cuando hay dos o más condenas anteriores. La propiedad valorada en $40 o más tomada de una vivienda o su terreno residencial no cercado queda sujeta, en cambio, a las reglas especiales de hurto mayor del párrafo (2)(d). Para una segunda condena o posterior por hurto menor a un comerciante, agricultor u organismo de transporte, §812.015(2) exige una multa de $50 a $1,000 o, en su lugar, servicio público designado por el tribunal. Un delito menor de primer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 1 año de cárcel y $1,000 de multa. Un delito grave de tercer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 5 años de prisión y $5,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito menor de primer grado pasa entonces a delito grave de tercer grado (máximos ordinarios de 5 años y $5,000). Un delito grave de tercer grado pasa entonces a segundo grado (máximos ordinarios de 15 años y $10,000).

zh.plainSummary: 从住宅或住宅未围合的附属区域盗取价值低于40美元的财产。
zh.degreeContext: 一级轻罪。曾因任何盗窃被定罪后实施本项住宅或附属区域内低于40美元的盗窃，构成三级重罪；第(2)(e)项也明确规定有两次以上盗窃前科时为三级重罪。从住宅或其未围合附属区域盗取价值40美元以上财产的，改按第(2)(d)项特别规定的重大盗窃规则处理。 如第二次或以后因从商家、农户或公共交通机构小额盗窃被定罪，第812.015(2)条要求罚款50至1,000美元，法院也可指定以公共服务代替。 一级轻罪通常最高可判监禁1年及罚款1,000美元。 三级重罪通常最高可判监禁5年及罚款5,000美元。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 一级轻罪因此升为三级重罪（通常最高5年及5,000美元）。 三级重罪因此升为二级重罪（通常最高15年及10,000美元）。

definitions.name: Petit theft of the first degree

en.plainSummary: Stealing property valued at $100 or more but less than $750, except property governed by paragraph (2)(d)'s special dwelling or unenclosed-curtilage rules.
en.degreeContext: First-degree misdemeanor. Under paragraph (2)(d), property in this value range taken from a dwelling or its unenclosed curtilage is grand theft of the third degree, not this petit-theft branch. For a second or later conviction for petit theft from a merchant, farmer or transit agency, §812.015(2) requires a $50–$1,000 fine or court-designated public service in its place. A first-degree misdemeanor ordinarily carries up to 1 year in jail and a $1,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A first-degree misdemeanor then becomes a third-degree felony (ordinary maximum 5 years and $5,000).

es.plainSummary: Hurtar propiedad valorada en $100 o más pero menos de $750, salvo la propiedad sujeta a las reglas especiales del párrafo (2)(d) para viviendas o su terreno residencial no cercado.
es.degreeContext: Delito menor de primer grado. Conforme al párrafo (2)(d), la propiedad de este valor tomada de una vivienda o su terreno residencial no cercado constituye hurto mayor de tercer grado, no esta modalidad de hurto menor. Para una segunda condena o posterior por hurto menor a un comerciante, agricultor u organismo de transporte, §812.015(2) exige una multa de $50 a $1,000 o, en su lugar, servicio público designado por el tribunal. Un delito menor de primer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 1 año de cárcel y $1,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito menor de primer grado pasa entonces a delito grave de tercer grado (máximos ordinarios de 5 años y $5,000).

zh.plainSummary: 盗取价值100美元以上但低于750美元的财产，但第(2)(d)项关于住宅或住宅未围合附属区域的特别规则所涵盖的财产除外。
zh.degreeContext: 一级轻罪。依第(2)(d)项，在此金额范围内从住宅或其未围合附属区域盗取财产构成三级重大盗窃，而不属于本轻微盗窃分支。 如第二次或以后因从商家、农户或公共交通机构小额盗窃被定罪，第812.015(2)条要求罚款50至1,000美元，法院也可指定以公共服务代替。 一级轻罪通常最高可判监禁1年及罚款1,000美元。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 一级轻罪因此升为三级重罪（通常最高5年及5,000美元）。

definitions.name: Petit theft of the second degree

en.plainSummary: Knowingly obtaining, using, or endeavoring to obtain or use another's property, with intent temporarily or permanently to deprive the other person of a right or benefit or to appropriate the property to an unauthorized use, when the property is not specified in subsection (2).
en.degreeContext: Second-degree misdemeanor. For retail gasoline taken by driving a vehicle away without paying, subsection (5), when applicable, also requires driver's-license suspension for up to 6 months for the first suspension and 1 year for a second or subsequent suspension. For a second or later conviction for petit theft from a merchant, farmer or transit agency, §812.015(2) requires a $50–$1,000 fine or court-designated public service in its place. A second-degree misdemeanor ordinarily carries up to 60 days and a $500 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A qualifying second-degree misdemeanor becomes a first-degree misdemeanor, ordinarily up to 1 year and $1,000.

es.plainSummary: Obtener, usar o intentar obtener o usar a sabiendas propiedad ajena, con intención temporal o permanente de privar a la otra persona de un derecho o beneficio, o de destinar la propiedad a un uso no autorizado, cuando la propiedad no está especificada en el inciso (2).
es.degreeContext: Delito menor de segundo grado. Cuando se toma gasolina al por menor alejando un vehículo sin pagar, el inciso (5), si corresponde, exige además suspender la licencia de conducir hasta 6 meses por la primera suspensión y por 1 año por la segunda o una posterior. Para una segunda condena o posterior por hurto menor a un comerciante, agricultor u organismo de transporte, §812.015(2) exige una multa de $50 a $1,000 o, en su lugar, servicio público designado por el tribunal. Un delito menor de segundo grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 60 días y $500 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Si se cumplen estos requisitos, el delito menor de segundo grado pasa a primer grado: ordinariamente hasta 1 año y $1,000.

zh.plainSummary: 明知地取得、使用或企图取得、使用他人财产，意图暂时或永久剥夺他人对财产的权利或利益，或者将财产挪作无权使用者之用，且该财产不属于第(2)款列明的财产。
zh.degreeContext: 二级轻罪。驾驶车辆离开零售加油场所而未支付油款的，在第(5)款适用时还须吊销驾驶证：首次最长6个月，第二次或其后为1年。 如第二次或以后因从商家、农户或公共交通机构小额盗窃被定罪，第812.015(2)条要求罚款50至1,000美元，法院也可指定以公共服务代替。 二级轻罪通常最高可判监禁60天及罚款500美元。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 如符合这些条件，二级轻罪升为一级轻罪，通常最高可判1年监禁及罚款1,000美元。

en.plainSummary: For petit theft governed by subsection (3), committing the offense after previously being convicted of any theft.
en.degreeContext: First-degree misdemeanor under paragraph (3)(b). The specific under-$40 dwelling or unenclosed-curtilage repeat branch in paragraph (2)(e) is a third-degree felony, and paragraph (3)(c) separately grades the subsection (3) branch after two or more prior theft convictions as a third-degree felony. For a second or later conviction for petit theft from a merchant, farmer or transit agency, §812.015(2) requires a $50–$1,000 fine or court-designated public service in its place. A first-degree misdemeanor ordinarily carries up to 1 year in jail and a $1,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A first-degree misdemeanor then becomes a third-degree felony (ordinary maximum 5 years and $5,000).

es.plainSummary: Para el hurto menor regido por el inciso (3), cometer el delito después de una condena anterior por cualquier hurto.
es.degreeContext: Delito menor de primer grado conforme al párrafo (3)(b). La modalidad específica del párrafo (2)(e), por hurto repetido de menos de $40 en una vivienda o su terreno residencial no cercado, es delito grave de tercer grado; el párrafo (3)(c) también clasifica por separado como delito grave de tercer grado la modalidad del inciso (3) después de dos o más condenas anteriores por hurto. Para una segunda condena o posterior por hurto menor a un comerciante, agricultor u organismo de transporte, §812.015(2) exige una multa de $50 a $1,000 o, en su lugar, servicio público designado por el tribunal. Un delito menor de primer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 1 año de cárcel y $1,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito menor de primer grado pasa entonces a delito grave de tercer grado (máximos ordinarios de 5 años y $5,000).

zh.plainSummary: 对于第(3)款所规范的轻微盗窃，在曾因任何盗窃被定罪后再次实施该罪。
zh.degreeContext: 依第(3)(b)项为一级轻罪。第(2)(e)项关于住宅或未围合附属区域内低于40美元盗窃的特定再犯分支为三级重罪；第(3)(c)项另行将有两次以上盗窃前科后实施的第(3)款分支定为三级重罪。 如第二次或以后因从商家、农户或公共交通机构小额盗窃被定罪，第812.015(2)条要求罚款50至1,000美元，法院也可指定以公共服务代替。 一级轻罪通常最高可判监禁1年及罚款1,000美元。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 一级轻罪因此升为三级重罪（通常最高5年及5,000美元）。

en.plainSummary: For petit theft governed by subsection (3), committing the offense after previously being convicted two or more times of any theft.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony. Paragraph (2)(e) separately supplies the same felony degree for its specific under-$40 dwelling or unenclosed-curtilage repeat branch. For a second or later conviction for petit theft from a merchant, farmer or transit agency, §812.015(2) requires a $50–$1,000 fine or court-designated public service in its place. A third-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 5 years in prison and a $5,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A third-degree felony then becomes a second-degree felony (ordinarily 15 years and $10,000 maximum).

es.plainSummary: Para el hurto menor regido por el inciso (3), cometer el delito después de dos o más condenas anteriores por cualquier hurto.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado. El párrafo (2)(e) establece por separado el mismo grado grave para su modalidad específica de hurto repetido de menos de $40 en una vivienda o su terreno residencial no cercado. Para una segunda condena o posterior por hurto menor a un comerciante, agricultor u organismo de transporte, §812.015(2) exige una multa de $50 a $1,000 o, en su lugar, servicio público designado por el tribunal. Un delito grave de tercer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 5 años de prisión y $5,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito grave de tercer grado pasa entonces a segundo grado (máximos ordinarios de 15 años y $10,000).

zh.plainSummary: 对于第(3)款所规范的轻微盗窃，在曾两次以上因任何盗窃被定罪后再次实施该罪。
zh.degreeContext: 三级重罪。第(2)(e)项对其特定的住宅或未围合附属区域内低于40美元盗窃再犯分支另行规定相同重罪等级。 如第二次或以后因从商家、农户或公共交通机构小额盗窃被定罪，第812.015(2)条要求罚款50至1,000美元，法院也可指定以公共服务代替。 三级重罪通常最高可判监禁5年及罚款5,000美元。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 三级重罪因此升为二级重罪（通常最高15年及10,000美元）。

en.plainSummary: Committing retail theft under one of the statute's coordinated, repeated, multi-location, aggregated-value, item-count, or group-participation circumstances.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony under subsection (8); second-degree felony under subsection (9), including specified repeat or higher-value conduct; and first-degree felony under subsection (11) for two or more prior convictions under subsections (8) or (9), or possession of a firearm during that offense. Restitution is mandatory and includes the value of stolen or damaged merchandise and the cost of repairing or replacing other property damaged during the offense. A third-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 5 years in prison and a $5,000 fine. A second-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 15 years in prison and a $10,000 fine. A first-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 30 years and a $10,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A third-degree felony then becomes a second-degree felony (ordinarily 15 years and $10,000 maximum). A second-degree felony then becomes a first-degree felony (ordinarily 30 years and $10,000 maximum). A first-degree felony then becomes a life felony (up to life and ordinarily a $15,000 fine).

es.plainSummary: Cometer hurto minorista bajo una de las circunstancias legales de coordinación, repetición, múltiples lugares, valor agregado, cantidad de artículos o participación grupal.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado conforme al inciso (8); de segundo grado conforme al inciso (9), incluso por ciertas reincidencias o mayor valor; y de primer grado conforme al inciso (11) por dos o más condenas anteriores bajo los incisos (8) o (9), o por poseer un arma de fuego durante el delito. La restitución es obligatoria e incluye el valor de la mercancía robada o dañada y el costo de reparar o reemplazar otros bienes dañados durante el delito. Un delito grave de tercer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 5 años de prisión y $5,000 de multa. Un delito grave de segundo grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 15 años de prisión y $10,000 de multa. Un delito grave de primer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 30 años y $10,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito grave de tercer grado pasa entonces a segundo grado (máximos ordinarios de 15 años y $10,000). Un delito grave de segundo grado pasa entonces a primer grado (máximos ordinarios de 30 años y $10,000). Un delito grave de primer grado pasa entonces a delito punible con cadena perpetua (hasta cadena perpetua y multa ordinaria de $15,000).

zh.plainSummary: 在法条规定的协同行动、重复实施、多地点、金额合并、物品数量或团伙参与等情形下实施零售盗窃。
zh.degreeContext: 第(8)款规定为三级重罪；第(9)款所列特定再犯或更高金额等情形为二级重罪；如对第(8)或第(9)款已有两次以上定罪，或犯罪时持有枪支，第(11)款规定为一级重罪。 必须赔偿被盗或损坏商品的价值以及修理或更换犯罪过程中受损的其他财产的费用。 三级重罪通常最高可判监禁5年及罚款5,000美元。 二级重罪通常最高可判监禁15年及罚款10,000美元。 一级重罪通常最高可判30年监禁及10,000美元罚款。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 三级重罪因此升为二级重罪（通常最高15年及10,000美元）。 二级重罪因此升为一级重罪（通常最高30年及10,000美元）。 一级重罪因此升为可判终身监禁的重罪（最高终身监禁及通常最高15,000美元罚款）。

en.plainSummary: Trafficking, or endeavoring to traffic, in property known or reasonably known to be stolen; the section also covers directing or managing a theft and trafficking in that stolen property.
en.degreeContext: Second-degree felony for trafficking or endeavoring to traffic in property the person knows or should know was stolen. First-degree felony when the person initiates, organizes, plans, finances, directs, manages, or supervises the theft and traffics in the stolen property. If theft and dealing are charged in separate counts for the same scheme or course of conduct, §812.025 allows a guilty verdict on only one of those counts. A second-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 15 years in prison and a $10,000 fine. A first-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 30 years and a $10,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A second-degree felony then becomes a first-degree felony (ordinarily 30 years and $10,000 maximum). A first-degree felony then becomes a life felony (up to life and ordinarily a $15,000 fine).

es.plainSummary: Traficar, o intentar traficar, con propiedad que se sabe o se debe saber que fue robada; la sección también abarca dirigir o administrar el hurto y traficar con esa propiedad.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de segundo grado por traficar o intentar traficar con propiedad que la persona sabe o debe saber que fue robada. Delito grave de primer grado si inicia, organiza, planea, financia, dirige, administra o supervisa el hurto y trafica con la propiedad robada. Cuando se imputan por separado el hurto y el tráfico de bienes robados por un mismo plan o curso de conducta, §812.025 permite un veredicto de culpabilidad por solo uno de esos cargos. Un delito grave de segundo grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 15 años de prisión y $10,000 de multa. Un delito grave de primer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 30 años y $10,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito grave de segundo grado pasa entonces a primer grado (máximos ordinarios de 30 años y $10,000). Un delito grave de primer grado pasa entonces a delito punible con cadena perpetua (hasta cadena perpetua y multa ordinaria de $15,000).

zh.plainSummary: 买卖或企图买卖明知或理应知道是赃物的财产；本条也涵盖指挥或管理盗窃并买卖该赃物。
zh.degreeContext: 买卖或企图买卖行为人明知或理应知道为赃物的财产，构成二级重罪。发起、组织、策划、资助、指挥、管理或监督盗窃并买卖该赃物的，构成一级重罪。 如果就同一计划或同一系列行为分别指控盗窃和交易赃物，第812.025条仅准许对其中一项作出有罪裁决。 二级重罪通常最高可判监禁15年及罚款10,000美元。 一级重罪通常最高可判30年监禁及10,000美元罚款。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 二级重罪因此升为一级重罪（通常最高30年及10,000美元）。 一级重罪因此升为可判终身监禁的重罪（最高终身监禁及通常最高15,000美元罚款）。

en.plainSummary: With intent to injure, defraud, or deceive an insurer, knowingly presenting, preparing, or concealing material false, incomplete, or misleading information in support of an insurance claim or application, as specified in subsection (1)(a).
en.degreeContext: The value involved controls the grade under subsection (11): third-degree felony below $20,000, second-degree felony from $20,000 to under $100,000, and first-degree felony at $100,000 or more. For a conviction involving an attempt to receive motor-vehicle insurance proceeds, subsection (12) adds a civil penalty: up to $5,000 for a first offense, over $5,000 through $10,000 for a second, and over $10,000 through $15,000 for a third or later offense under this branch. A third-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 5 years in prison and a $5,000 fine. A second-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 15 years in prison and a $10,000 fine. A first-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 30 years and a $10,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A third-degree felony then becomes a second-degree felony (ordinarily 15 years and $10,000 maximum). A second-degree felony then becomes a first-degree felony (ordinarily 30 years and $10,000 maximum). A first-degree felony then becomes a life felony (up to life and ordinarily a $15,000 fine).

es.plainSummary: Con intención de perjudicar, defraudar o engañar a una aseguradora, presentar o preparar a sabiendas información material falsa, incompleta o engañosa, u ocultarla, en apoyo de una reclamación o solicitud de seguro según el inciso (1)(a).
es.degreeContext: El valor involucrado determina el grado conforme al inciso (11): delito grave de tercer grado por menos de $20,000, de segundo grado desde $20,000 hasta menos de $100,000 y de primer grado por $100,000 o más. Si la condena es por actos con el fin de cobrar un seguro de automóvil, el apartado (12) añade una multa civil de hasta $5,000 la primera vez, más de $5,000 y hasta $10,000 la segunda, y más de $10,000 y hasta $15,000 la tercera o posterior en esta modalidad. Un delito grave de tercer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 5 años de prisión y $5,000 de multa. Un delito grave de segundo grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 15 años de prisión y $10,000 de multa. Un delito grave de primer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 30 años y $10,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito grave de tercer grado pasa entonces a segundo grado (máximos ordinarios de 15 años y $10,000). Un delito grave de segundo grado pasa entonces a primer grado (máximos ordinarios de 30 años y $10,000). Un delito grave de primer grado pasa entonces a delito punible con cadena perpetua (hasta cadena perpetua y multa ordinaria de $15,000).

zh.plainSummary: 意图损害、欺诈或欺骗保险人，依第(1)(a)款在保险理赔或申请中明知地提交、制作或隐瞒重大虚假、不完整或误导性信息。
zh.degreeContext: 第(11)款按涉及财产价值分级：低于20,000美元为三级重罪；20,000美元以上但低于100,000美元为二级重罪；100,000美元以上为一级重罪。 如实施本项行为是为了取得汽车保险赔款，定罪后第(12)款另加民事罚款：初犯最高5,000美元，第二次超过5,000且不超过10,000美元，第三次及以后超过10,000且不超过15,000美元。 三级重罪通常最高可判监禁5年及罚款5,000美元。 二级重罪通常最高可判监禁15年及罚款10,000美元。 一级重罪通常最高可判30年监禁及10,000美元罚款。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 三级重罪因此升为二级重罪（通常最高15年及10,000美元）。 二级重罪因此升为一级重罪（通常最高30年及10,000美元）。 一级重罪因此升为可判终身监禁的重罪（最高终身监禁及通常最高15,000美元罚款）。

definitions.name: Fraudulent use of personal identification information

names.es: Uso fraudulento de información de identificación personal
names.zh: 欺诈使用个人身份信息

en.plainSummary: Willfully and without authorization fraudulently using, or possessing with intent to fraudulently use, another person's personal identification information without consent.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony under subsection (2)(a). It becomes a second- or first-degree felony under subsections (2)(b)-(c) at the specified benefit, loss, injury, fraud, or victim-count thresholds, with stated mandatory minimum terms. The higher tiers require actual fraudulent use. Monetary benefit, value of services, payment sought to be avoided, or amount of injury or fraud of at least $5,000, or 10–19 affected identities, triggers a second-degree felony with a 3-year minimum. At least $50,000 or 20–29 identities triggers a first-degree felony with a 5-year minimum. At least $100,000 or 30 or more identities carries a 10-year minimum. A guilty or no-contest plea or guilty finding carries a mandatory $1,001 surcharge regardless of adjudication. The court may order restitution. Use of a public record to facilitate the offense under (5), or specified impersonation to obtain or use identification under (10), can raise a first-degree misdemeanor to a third-degree felony, a third-degree felony to second degree, or a second-degree felony to first degree. Only (10) lists an increase from a first-degree felony to a life felony. Under (13), substantial assistance may support a reduced or suspended sentence on the prosecutor’s motion. A third-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 5 years in prison and a $5,000 fine. A second-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 15 years in prison and a $10,000 fine. A first-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 30 years and a $10,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A third-degree felony then becomes a second-degree felony (ordinarily 15 years and $10,000 maximum). A second-degree felony then becomes a first-degree felony (ordinarily 30 years and $10,000 maximum). A first-degree felony then becomes a life felony (up to life and ordinarily a $15,000 fine).

es.plainSummary: Usar fraudulentamente, de manera intencional y sin autorización, la información de identificación personal de otra persona sin consentimiento, o poseerla con intención de usarla fraudulentamente.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado conforme al inciso (2)(a). Pasa a segundo o primer grado bajo los incisos (2)(b)-(c) al alcanzar los umbrales especificados de beneficio, pérdida, lesión, fraude o número de víctimas, con penas mínimas obligatorias indicadas. Los grados superiores exigen uso fraudulento efectivo. Si el beneficio monetario, el valor de los servicios, el pago que se quiso evitar o el monto del daño o fraude llega a $5,000, o se usan 10–19 identidades, es delito grave de segundo grado con mínimo de 3 años. Con $50,000 o más o 20–29 identidades es de primer grado con mínimo de 5 años. Con $100,000 o más o al menos 30 identidades el mínimo es de 10 años. Un reconocimiento de culpabilidad, una declaración de no oposición o una determinación de culpabilidad conlleva un recargo obligatorio de $1,001 aunque se reserve la adjudicación. El tribunal puede ordenar restitución. Usar un registro público para facilitar el delito según (5), o la suplantación especificada para obtener o usar información según (10), puede elevar el delito menor de primer grado a grave de tercero, el grave de tercero a segundo o el grave de segundo a primero. Solo (10) enumera el aumento del primer grado a delito grave castigable con cadena perpetua. Según (13), el fiscal puede solicitar reducción o suspensión por colaboración sustancial. Un delito grave de tercer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 5 años de prisión y $5,000 de multa. Un delito grave de segundo grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 15 años de prisión y $10,000 de multa. Un delito grave de primer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 30 años y $10,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito grave de tercer grado pasa entonces a segundo grado (máximos ordinarios de 15 años y $10,000). Un delito grave de segundo grado pasa entonces a primer grado (máximos ordinarios de 30 años y $10,000). Un delito grave de primer grado pasa entonces a delito punible con cadena perpetua (hasta cadena perpetua y multa ordinaria de $15,000).

zh.plainSummary: 故意且未经授权，在未获同意的情况下欺诈使用他人的个人身份信息，或持有该信息并意图欺诈使用。
zh.degreeContext: 第(2)(a)款为三级重罪。达到第(2)(b)-(c)款规定的收益、损失、伤害、欺诈金额或受害人数门槛时，升为二级或一级重罪，并适用所列强制最低刑期。 加重等级要求实际欺诈使用。金钱利益、服务价值、试图避免的付款或损害或欺诈金额达到5,000美元，或涉及10至19个身份，为二级重罪，最低3年。达到50,000美元或涉及20至29个身份，为一级重罪，最低5年；达到100,000美元或涉及至少30个身份，最低10年。 认罪、不抗辩答辩或被认定有罪均须缴纳1,001美元附加费，即使暂缓正式定罪也适用。法院可以命令赔偿。第(5)款所指利用公共记录便利犯罪，或第(10)款规定的通过冒充特定身份获取或使用身份信息，可将一级轻罪升为三级重罪、三级重罪升为二级或二级升为一级。只有第(10)款列出从一级重罪升为可判终身监禁重罪。依第(13)款，经检方申请，提供重大协助可获减刑或暂停执行。 三级重罪通常最高可判监禁5年及罚款5,000美元。 二级重罪通常最高可判监禁15年及罚款10,000美元。 一级重罪通常最高可判30年监禁及10,000美元罚款。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 三级重罪因此升为二级重罪（通常最高15年及10,000美元）。 二级重罪因此升为一级重罪（通常最高30年及10,000美元）。 一级重罪因此升为可判终身监禁的重罪（最高终身监禁及通常最高15,000美元罚款）。

definitions.name: Harassment by use of personal identification information

names.es: Acoso mediante el uso de información de identificación personal
names.zh: 利用个人身份信息进行骚扰

en.plainSummary: Willfully and without authorization possessing, using, or attempting to use a person's personal identification information without consent for the purpose of harassing that person.

Use of a public record to facilitate the offense under (5), or specified impersonation to obtain or use identification under (10), can raise a first-degree misdemeanor to a third-degree felony, a third-degree felony to second degree, or a second-degree felony to first degree. Only (10) lists an increase from a first-degree felony to a life felony. Under (13), substantial assistance may support a reduced or suspended sentence on the prosecutor’s motion. Harassment requires conduct aimed at a specific person, intended to cause substantial emotional distress, without a legitimate purpose. Constitutionally protected conduct and accepted commercial uses are excluded. A first-degree misdemeanor ordinarily carries up to 1 year in jail and a $1,000 fine. A third-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 5 years in prison and a $5,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A first-degree misdemeanor then becomes a third-degree felony (ordinary maximum 5 years and $5,000). A third-degree felony then becomes a second-degree felony (ordinarily 15 years and $10,000 maximum).

es.plainSummary: Poseer, usar o intentar usar intencionalmente y sin autorización la información de identificación personal de una persona, sin su consentimiento, con el propósito de acosarla.

El acoso exige conducta dirigida a una persona específica con intención de causar angustia emocional sustancial y sin propósito legítimo. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito menor de primer grado pasa entonces a delito grave de tercer grado (máximos ordinarios de 5 años y $5,000). Un delito grave de tercer grado pasa entonces a segundo grado (máximos ordinarios de 15 años y $10,000).

zh.plainSummary: 为骚扰某人，故意且未经授权，在未获同意的情况下持有、使用或企图使用该人的个人身份信息。
zh.degreeContext: 一级轻罪。本条另规定，如公共记录促成犯罪或使用特定虚假身份陈述，罪名可升格。 认罪、不抗辩答辩或被认定有罪均须缴纳1,001美元附加费，即使暂缓正式定罪也适用。法院可以命令赔偿。第(5)款所指利用公共记录便利犯罪，或第(10)款规定的通过冒充特定身份获取或使用身份信息，可将一级轻罪升为三级重罪、三级重罪升为二级或二级升为一级。只有第(10)款列出从一级重罪升为可判终身监禁重罪。依第(13)款，经检方申请，提供重大协助可获减刑或暂停执行。 骚扰须针对特定的人，意图造成严重精神痛苦且没有正当目的。受宪法保护的行为与公认的商业用途不在此限。 一级轻罪通常最高可判监禁1年及罚款1,000美元。 三级重罪通常最高可判监禁5年及罚款5,000美元。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 一级轻罪因此升为三级重罪（通常最高5年及5,000美元）。 三级重罪因此升为二级重罪（通常最高15年及10,000美元）。

definitions.name: Fraudulent creation or use, or possession with intent to fraudulently use, counterfeit or fictitious personal identification information

names.es: Creación o uso fraudulento, o posesión con intención de usar, información de identificación personal falsificada o ficticia
names.zh: 欺诈制作、使用或意图欺诈使用而持有伪造或虚构的个人身份信息

en.plainSummary: Willfully and fraudulently creating, using, or possessing with intent to fraudulently use counterfeit or fictitious personal identification information, with intent to commit or facilitate a fraud on another person.
en.degreeContext: Third-degree felony. The section excludes lawfully authorized governmental investigative, protective, or intelligence activity. A guilty or no-contest plea or guilty finding carries a mandatory $1,001 surcharge regardless of adjudication. The court may order restitution. Use of a public record to facilitate the offense under (5), or specified impersonation to obtain or use identification under (10), can raise a first-degree misdemeanor to a third-degree felony, a third-degree felony to second degree, or a second-degree felony to first degree. Only (10) lists an increase from a first-degree felony to a life felony. Under (13), substantial assistance may support a reduced or suspended sentence on the prosecutor’s motion. The information may concern a fictitious person. When it concerns a real person, this branch requires absence of that person’s consent. A third-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 5 years in prison and a $5,000 fine. A second-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 15 years in prison and a $10,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A third-degree felony then becomes a second-degree felony (ordinarily 15 years and $10,000 maximum). A second-degree felony then becomes a first-degree felony (ordinarily 30 years and $10,000 maximum).

es.plainSummary: Crear, usar o poseer intencional y fraudulentamente información de identificación personal falsificada o ficticia, con intención de cometer o facilitar un fraude contra otra persona.
es.degreeContext: Delito grave de tercer grado. La sección excluye actividades gubernamentales de investigación, protección o inteligencia legalmente autorizadas. Un reconocimiento de culpabilidad, una declaración de no oposición o una determinación de culpabilidad conlleva un recargo obligatorio de $1,001 aunque se reserve la adjudicación. El tribunal puede ordenar restitución. Usar un registro público para facilitar el delito según (5), o la suplantación especificada para obtener o usar información según (10), puede elevar el delito menor de primer grado a grave de tercero, el grave de tercero a segundo o el grave de segundo a primero. Solo (10) enumera el aumento del primer grado a delito grave castigable con cadena perpetua. Según (13), el fiscal puede solicitar reducción o suspensión por colaboración sustancial. La información puede referirse a una persona ficticia. Si corresponde a una persona real, esta modalidad exige que dicha persona no haya dado su consentimiento. Un delito grave de tercer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 5 años de prisión y $5,000 de multa. Un delito grave de segundo grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 15 años de prisión y $10,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito grave de tercer grado pasa entonces a segundo grado (máximos ordinarios de 15 años y $10,000). Un delito grave de segundo grado pasa entonces a primer grado (máximos ordinarios de 30 años y $10,000).

zh.plainSummary: 故意且欺诈地制作、使用，或意图欺诈使用而持有伪造或虚构的个人身份信息，并意图对他人实施或协助实施欺诈。
zh.degreeContext: 三级重罪。本条不适用于依法授权的政府调查、保护或情报活动。 认罪、不抗辩答辩或被认定有罪均须缴纳1,001美元附加费，即使暂缓正式定罪也适用。法院可以命令赔偿。第(5)款所指利用公共记录便利犯罪，或第(10)款规定的通过冒充特定身份获取或使用身份信息，可将一级轻罪升为三级重罪、三级重罪升为二级或二级升为一级。只有第(10)款列出从一级重罪升为可判终身监禁重罪。依第(13)款，经检方申请，提供重大协助可获减刑或暂停执行。 所涉信息可以涉及虚构的人。如涉及真实的人，此项指控要求该人未同意。 三级重罪通常最高可判监禁5年及罚款5,000美元。 二级重罪通常最高可判监禁15年及罚款10,000美元。 对2026年7月1日及以后的行为，若本罪本身符合第741.28条家庭暴力定义且行为人当时已有符合条件的家庭暴力定罪，第741.2801条要求提高罪级。此类指控须有个案证据证明身体伤害或死亡及家庭或住户关系。共有子女的父母适用共同居住要求的例外。仅凭指控不能认定这些条件。 三级重罪因此升为二级重罪（通常最高15年及10,000美元）。 二级重罪因此升为一级重罪（通常最高30年及10,000美元）。

names.es: Uso fraudulento de tarjetas de crédito

en.plainSummary: With intent to defraud, using a wrongfully obtained, retained, or forged credit card, or falsely representing cardholder status, to obtain money, goods, services, or another thing of value.
en.degreeContext: First-degree misdemeanor when, in six months, the card is used two or fewer times or the value obtained is under $100. Third-degree felony when it is used more than twice or the value is $100 or more. The filed count and its six-month use or value allegation determine which §817.67 penalty is at issue. A first-degree misdemeanor ordinarily carries up to 1 year in jail and a $1,000 fine. A third-degree felony ordinarily carries up to 5 years in prison and a $5,000 fine. For conduct on or after July 1, 2026, §741.2801 requires reclassification if this offense itself qualifies as domestic violence under §741.28 and the accused already had a qualifying domestic-violence conviction at the time. The injury-or-death and family or household requirements need case-specific evidence. The shared-residence rule excepts parents of a child in common. The charge alone does not establish these conditions. A first-degree misdemeanor then becomes a third-degree felony (ordinary maximum 5 years and $5,000). A third-degree felony then becomes a second-degree felony (ordinarily 15 years and $10,000 maximum).

es.plainSummary: Con intención de defraudar, usar una tarjeta de crédito obtenida, retenida o falsificada indebidamente, o afirmar falsamente ser su titular, para obtener dinero, bienes, servicios u otra cosa de valor.
es.degreeContext: Delito menor de primer grado cuando, en seis meses, la tarjeta se usa dos veces o menos o el valor obtenido es menor de $100. Delito grave de tercer grado si se usa más de dos veces o el valor es de $100 o más. El cargo presentado y la alegación sobre uso o valor dentro de seis meses determinan qué pena de §817.67 está en cuestión. Un delito menor de primer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 1 año de cárcel y $1,000 de multa. Un delito grave de tercer grado conlleva ordinariamente hasta 5 años de prisión y $5,000 de multa. Para hechos desde el 1 de julio de 2026, el §741.2801 exige reclasificar si este delito constituye violencia doméstica según el §741.28 y el acusado ya tenía una condena pertinente al ocurrir los hechos. La lesión física o muerte y la relación familiar o doméstica exigen pruebas específicas. La regla de convivencia exceptúa a los progenitores de un hijo en común. La acusación por sí sola no acredita esas condiciones. Un delito menor de primer grado pasa entonces a delito grave de tercer grado (máximos ordinarios de 5 años y $5,000). Un delito grave de tercer grado pasa entonces a segundo grado (máximos ordinarios de 15 años y $10,000).

zh.plainSummary: 意图欺诈，使用非法取得、保留或伪造的信用卡，或虚假声称持卡人身份，以取得金钱、商品、服务或其他有价物。

fl:statute:812.014:2_e.title: Theft
fl:statute:812.014:2_e.text:
812.014 
Theft.
—

(1) 
A person commits theft if he or she knowingly obtains or uses, or endeavors to obtain or to use, the property of another with intent to, either temporarily or permanently:
(a) 
Deprive the other person of a right to the property or a benefit from the property.

(b) 
Appropriate the property to his or her own use or to the use of any person not entitled to the use of the property.

(2)(a)1. 
If the property stolen is valued at $100,000 or more or is a semitrailer that was deployed by a law enforcement officer; or

2. 
If the property stolen is cargo valued at $50,000 or more that has entered the stream of interstate or intrastate commerce from the shipper’s loading platform to the consignee’s receiving dock; or

3. 
If the offender commits any grand theft and:
a. 
In the course of committing the offense the offender uses a motor vehicle as an instrumentality, other than merely as a getaway vehicle, to assist in committing the offense and thereby damages the real property of another; or

b. 
In the course of committing the offense the offender causes damage to the real or personal property of another in excess of $1,000,

the offender commits grand theft in the first degree, punishable as a felony of the first degree, as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.

(b)1. 
If the property stolen is valued at $20,000 or more, but less than $100,000;

2. 
If the property stolen is cargo valued at less than $50,000 that has entered the stream of interstate or intrastate commerce from the shipper’s loading platform to the consignee’s receiving dock;

3. 
If the property stolen is emergency medical equipment, valued at $300 or more, that is taken from a facility licensed under chapter 395 or from an aircraft or vehicle permitted under chapter 401; or

4. 
If the property stolen is law enforcement equipment, valued at $300 or more, that is taken from an authorized emergency vehicle, as defined in s. 316.003,

the offender commits grand theft in the second degree, punishable as a felony of the second degree, as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084. Emergency medical equipment means mechanical or electronic apparatus used to provide emergency services and care as defined in s. 395.002(9) or to treat medical emergencies. Law enforcement equipment means any property, device, or apparatus used by any law enforcement officer as defined in s. 943.10 in the officer’s official business. However, if the property is stolen during a riot or an aggravated riot prohibited under s. 870.01 and the perpetration of the theft is facilitated by conditions arising from the riot; or within a county that is subject to a state of emergency declared by the Governor under chapter 252, the theft is committed after the declaration of emergency is made, and the perpetration of the theft is facilitated by conditions arising from the emergency, the theft is a felony of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084. As used in this paragraph, the term “conditions arising from the riot” means civil unrest, power outages, curfews, or a reduction in the presence of or response time for first responders or homeland security personnel and the term “conditions arising from the emergency” means civil unrest, power outages, curfews, voluntary or mandatory evacuations, or a reduction in the presence of or response time for first responders or homeland security personnel. A person arrested for committing a theft during a riot or an aggravated riot or within a county that is subject to a state of emergency may not be released until the person appears before a committing magistrate at a first appearance hearing. For purposes of sentencing under chapter 921, a felony offense that is reclassified under this paragraph is ranked one level above the ranking under s. 921.0022 or s. 921.0023 of the offense committed.

(c) 
It is grand theft of the third degree and a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is:
1. 
Valued at $750 or more, but less than $5,000.

2. 
Valued at $5,000 or more, but less than $10,000.

3. 
Valued at $10,000 or more, but less than $20,000.

4. 
A will, codicil, or other testamentary instrument.

5. 
A firearm, except as provided in paragraph (g).

6. 
A motor vehicle, except as provided in paragraph (a).

7. 
Any commercially farmed animal, including any animal of the equine, avian, bovine, or swine class or other grazing animal; a bee colony of a registered beekeeper; and aquaculture species raised at a certified aquaculture facility. If the property stolen is a commercially farmed animal, including an animal of the equine, avian, bovine, or swine class or other grazing animal; a bee colony of a registered beekeeper; or an aquaculture species raised at a certified aquaculture facility, a $10,000 fine shall be imposed.

8. 
Any fire extinguisher that, at the time of the taking, was installed in any building for the purpose of fire prevention and control. This subparagraph does not apply to a fire extinguisher taken from the inventory at a point-of-sale business.

9. 
Any amount of citrus fruit consisting of 2,000 or more individual pieces of fruit.

10. 
Taken from a designated construction site identified by the posting of a sign as provided for in s. 810.09(2)(c).

11. 
Any stop sign.

12. 
Anhydrous ammonia.

13. 
Any amount of a controlled substance as defined in s. 893.02. Notwithstanding any other law, separate judgments and sentences for theft of a controlled substance under this subparagraph and for any applicable possession of controlled substance offense under s. 893.13 or trafficking in controlled substance offense under s. 893.135 may be imposed when all such offenses involve the same amount or amounts of a controlled substance.

However, if the property is stolen during a riot or an aggravated riot prohibited under s. 870.01 and the perpetration of the theft is facilitated by conditions arising from the riot; or within a county that is subject to a state of emergency declared by the Governor under chapter 252, the property is stolen after the declaration of emergency is made, and the perpetration of the theft is facilitated by conditions arising from the emergency, the offender commits a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property is valued at $5,000 or more, but less than $10,000, as provided under subparagraph 2., or if the property is valued at $10,000 or more, but less than $20,000, as provided under subparagraph 3. As used in this paragraph, the terms “conditions arising from a riot” and “conditions arising from the emergency” have the same meanings as provided in paragraph (b). A person arrested for committing a theft during a riot or an aggravated riot or within a county that is subject to a state of emergency may not be released until the person appears before a committing magistrate at a first appearance hearing. For purposes of sentencing under chapter 921, a felony offense that is reclassified under this paragraph is ranked one level above the ranking under s. 921.0022 or s. 921.0023 of the offense committed.

(d)1. 
It is grand theft of the third degree and a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is valued at $40 or more, but less than $750, and is taken from a dwelling as defined in s. 810.011(2) or from the unenclosed curtilage of a dwelling pursuant to s. 810.09(1).

2. 
It is grand theft of the third degree and a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is valued at $750 or more and is taken from a dwelling as defined in s. 810.011(2) or from the unenclosed curtilage of a dwelling pursuant to s. 810.09(1).

3. 
It is grand theft of the second degree and a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is taken from more than 20 dwellings as defined in s. 810.011(2) or from the unenclosed curtilage of more than 20 dwellings pursuant to s. 810.09(1), or any combination thereof.

(e)1. 
It is petit theft of the first degree and a misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083, if the property stolen is valued at less than $40 and is taken from a dwelling as defined in s. 810.011(2) or from the unenclosed curtilage of a dwelling pursuant to s. 810.09(1).

2. 
A person who commits a violation of subparagraph 1. and who has previously been convicted of any theft commits a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

3. 
A person who commits a violation of subparagraph 1. and who has previously been convicted two or more times of any theft commits a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

(f) 
Except as provided in paragraph (d), if the property stolen is valued at $100 or more, but less than $750, the offender commits petit theft of the first degree, punishable as a misdemeanor of the first degree, as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

(g) 
It is grand theft of the second degree and a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is a firearm and the offender has previously been convicted of grand theft of a firearm under subparagraph (c)5.

(3)(a) 
Theft of any property not specified in subsection (2) is petit theft of the second degree and a misdemeanor of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083, and as provided in subsection (5), as applicable.

(b) 
A person who commits petit theft and who has previously been convicted of any theft commits a misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

(c) 
A person who commits petit theft and who has previously been convicted two or more times of any theft commits a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

(d)1. 
A judgment of guilty or not guilty of a petit theft must be in:
a. 
A written record that is signed by the judge and recorded by the clerk of the circuit court; or

b. 
An electronic record that contains the judge’s electronic signature as defined in s. 933.40 and is recorded by the clerk of the circuit court.

2. 
A judge shall cause the fingerprints of a defendant who is found guilty of petit theft to be manually taken or electronically captured. Such fingerprints must be certified and filed in the case in which the judgment of guilty is entered as provided in s. 921.241(3).

3. 
A written or an electronic judgment of guilty of a petit theft, or a certified copy thereof, is admissible in evidence in the courts of this state as provided in s. 921.241(4).

(4) 
Failure to comply with the terms of a lease when the lease is for a term of 1 year or longer shall not constitute a violation of this section unless demand for the return of the property leased has been made in writing and the lessee has failed to return the property within 7 days of his or her receipt of the demand for return of the property. A demand mailed by certified or registered mail, evidenced by return receipt, to the last known address of the lessee shall be deemed sufficient and equivalent to the demand having been received by the lessee, whether such demand shall be returned undelivered or not.

(5)(a) 
No person shall drive a motor vehicle so as to cause it to leave the premises of an establishment at which gasoline offered for retail sale was dispensed into the fuel tank of such motor vehicle unless the payment of authorized charge for the gasoline dispensed has been made.

(b) 
In addition to the penalties prescribed in paragraph (3)(a), every judgment of guilty of a petit theft for property described in this subsection shall provide for the suspension of the convicted person’s driver license. The court shall forward the driver license to the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles in accordance with s. 322.25.
1. 
The first suspension of a driver license under this subsection shall be for a period of up to 6 months.

2. 
The second or subsequent suspension of a driver license under this subsection shall be for a period of 1 year.

(6) 
A person who individually, or in concert with one or more other persons, coordinates the activities of one or more persons in committing theft under this section where the stolen property has a value in excess of $3,000 commits a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.

(7) 
The Office of Program Policy Analysis and Government Accountability (OPPAGA) shall perform a study every 5 years to determine the appropriateness of the threshold amounts included in this section. The study’s scope must include, but need not be limited to, the crime trends related to theft offenses, the theft threshold amounts of other states in effect at the time of the study, the fiscal impact of any modifications to this state’s threshold amounts, and the effect on economic factors, such as inflation. The study must include options for amending the threshold amounts if the study finds that such amounts are inconsistent with current trends. In conducting the study, OPPAGA shall consult with the Office of Economic and Demographic Research in addition to other interested entities. OPPAGA shall submit a report to the Governor, the President of the Senate, and the Speaker of the House of Representatives by September 1 of every 5th year.

If the property stolen is valued at $100,000 or more or is a semitrailer that was deployed by a law enforcement officer; or

2. 
If the property stolen is cargo valued at $50,000 or more that has entered the stream of interstate or intrastate commerce from the shipper’s loading platform to the consignee’s receiving dock; or

3. 
If the offender commits any grand theft and:
a. 
In the course of committing the offense the offender uses a motor vehicle as an instrumentality, other than merely as a getaway vehicle, to assist in committing the offense and thereby damages the real property of another; or

b. 
In the course of committing the offense the offender causes damage to the real or personal property of another in excess of $1,000,

the offender commits grand theft in the first degree, punishable as a felony of the first degree, as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.

(b)1. 
If the property stolen is valued at $20,000 or more, but less than $100,000;

2. 
If the property stolen is cargo valued at less than $50,000 that has entered the stream of interstate or intrastate commerce from the shipper’s loading platform to the consignee’s receiving dock;

3. 
If the property stolen is emergency medical equipment, valued at $300 or more, that is taken from a facility licensed under chapter 395 or from an aircraft or vehicle permitted under chapter 401; or

4. 
If the property stolen is law enforcement equipment, valued at $300 or more, that is taken from an authorized emergency vehicle, as defined in s. 316.003,

the offender commits grand theft in the second degree, punishable as a felony of the second degree, as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084. Emergency medical equipment means mechanical or electronic apparatus used to provide emergency services and care as defined in s. 395.002(9) or to treat medical emergencies. Law enforcement equipment means any property, device, or apparatus used by any law enforcement officer as defined in s. 943.10 in the officer’s official business. However, if the property is stolen during a riot or an aggravated riot prohibited under s. 870.01 and the perpetration of the theft is facilitated by conditions arising from the riot; or within a county that is subject to a state of emergency declared by the Governor under chapter 252, the theft is committed after the declaration of emergency is made, and the perpetration of the theft is facilitated by conditions arising from the emergency, the theft is a felony of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084. As used in this paragraph, the term “conditions arising from the riot” means civil unrest, power outages, curfews, or a reduction in the presence of or response time for first responders or homeland security personnel and the term “conditions arising from the emergency” means civil unrest, power outages, curfews, voluntary or mandatory evacuations, or a reduction in the presence of or response time for first responders or homeland security personnel. A person arrested for committing a theft during a riot or an aggravated riot or within a county that is subject to a state of emergency may not be released until the person appears before a committing magistrate at a first appearance hearing. For purposes of sentencing under chapter 921, a felony offense that is reclassified under this paragraph is ranked one level above the ranking under s. 921.0022 or s. 921.0023 of the offense committed.

(c) 
It is grand theft of the third degree and a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is:
1. 
Valued at $750 or more, but less than $5,000.

2. 
Valued at $5,000 or more, but less than $10,000.

3. 
Valued at $10,000 or more, but less than $20,000.

4. 
A will, codicil, or other testamentary instrument.

5. 
A firearm, except as provided in paragraph (g).

6. 
A motor vehicle, except as provided in paragraph (a).

7. 
Any commercially farmed animal, including any animal of the equine, avian, bovine, or swine class or other grazing animal; a bee colony of a registered beekeeper; and aquaculture species raised at a certified aquaculture facility. If the property stolen is a commercially farmed animal, including an animal of the equine, avian, bovine, or swine class or other grazing animal; a bee colony of a registered beekeeper; or an aquaculture species raised at a certified aquaculture facility, a $10,000 fine shall be imposed.

8. 
Any fire extinguisher that, at the time of the taking, was installed in any building for the purpose of fire prevention and control. This subparagraph does not apply to a fire extinguisher taken from the inventory at a point-of-sale business.

9. 
Any amount of citrus fruit consisting of 2,000 or more individual pieces of fruit.

10. 
Taken from a designated construction site identified by the posting of a sign as provided for in s. 810.09(2)(c).

11. 
Any stop sign.

12. 
Anhydrous ammonia.

13. 
Any amount of a controlled substance as defined in s. 893.02. Notwithstanding any other law, separate judgments and sentences for theft of a controlled substance under this subparagraph and for any applicable possession of controlled substance offense under s. 893.13 or trafficking in controlled substance offense under s. 893.135 may be imposed when all such offenses involve the same amount or amounts of a controlled substance.

However, if the property is stolen during a riot or an aggravated riot prohibited under s. 870.01 and the perpetration of the theft is facilitated by conditions arising from the riot; or within a county that is subject to a state of emergency declared by the Governor under chapter 252, the property is stolen after the declaration of emergency is made, and the perpetration of the theft is facilitated by conditions arising from the emergency, the offender commits a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property is valued at $5,000 or more, but less than $10,000, as provided under subparagraph 2., or if the property is valued at $10,000 or more, but less than $20,000, as provided under subparagraph 3. As used in this paragraph, the terms “conditions arising from a riot” and “conditions arising from the emergency” have the same meanings as provided in paragraph (b). A person arrested for committing a theft during a riot or an aggravated riot or within a county that is subject to a state of emergency may not be released until the person appears before a committing magistrate at a first appearance hearing. For purposes of sentencing under chapter 921, a felony offense that is reclassified under this paragraph is ranked one level above the ranking under s. 921.0022 or s. 921.0023 of the offense committed.

(d)1. 
It is grand theft of the third degree and a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is valued at $40 or more, but less than $750, and is taken from a dwelling as defined in s. 810.011(2) or from the unenclosed curtilage of a dwelling pursuant to s. 810.09(1).

2. 
It is grand theft of the third degree and a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is valued at $750 or more and is taken from a dwelling as defined in s. 810.011(2) or from the unenclosed curtilage of a dwelling pursuant to s. 810.09(1).

3. 
It is grand theft of the second degree and a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is taken from more than 20 dwellings as defined in s. 810.011(2) or from the unenclosed curtilage of more than 20 dwellings pursuant to s. 810.09(1), or any combination thereof.

(e)1. 
It is petit theft of the first degree and a misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083, if the property stolen is valued at less than $40 and is taken from a dwelling as defined in s. 810.011(2) or from the unenclosed curtilage of a dwelling pursuant to s. 810.09(1).

2. 
A person who commits a violation of subparagraph 1. and who has previously been convicted of any theft commits a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

3. 
A person who commits a violation of subparagraph 1. and who has previously been convicted two or more times of any theft commits a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

(f) 
Except as provided in paragraph (d), if the property stolen is valued at $100 or more, but less than $750, the offender commits petit theft of the first degree, punishable as a misdemeanor of the first degree, as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

(g) 
It is grand theft of the second degree and a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084, if the property stolen is a firearm and the offender has previously been convicted of grand theft of a firearm under subparagraph (c)5.

(3)(a) 
Theft of any property not specified in subsection (2) is petit theft of the second degree and a misdemeanor of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083, and as provided in subsection (5), as applicable.

(b) 
A person who commits petit theft and who has previously been convicted of any theft commits a misdemeanor of the first degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

(c) 
A person who commits petit theft and who has previously been convicted two or more times of any theft commits a felony of the third degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082 or s. 775.083.

(d)1. 
A judgment of guilty or not guilty of a petit theft must be in:
a. 
A written record that is signed by the judge and recorded by the clerk of the circuit court; or

b. 
An electronic record that contains the judge’s electronic signature as defined in s. 933.40 and is recorded by the clerk of the circuit court.

2. 
A judge shall cause the fingerprints of a defendant who is found guilty of petit theft to be manually taken or electronically captured. Such fingerprints must be certified and filed in the case in which the judgment of guilty is entered as provided in s. 921.241(3).

3. 
A written or an electronic judgment of guilty of a petit theft, or a certified copy thereof, is admissible in evidence in the courts of this state as provided in s. 921.241(4).

(4) 
Failure to comply with the terms of a lease when the lease is for a term of 1 year or longer shall not constitute a violation of this section unless demand for the return of the property leased has been made in writing and the lessee has failed to return the property within 7 days of his or her receipt of the demand for return of the property. A demand mailed by certified or registered mail, evidenced by return receipt, to the last known address of the lessee shall be deemed sufficient and equivalent to the demand having been received by the lessee, whether such demand shall be returned undelivered or not.

(5)(a) 
No person shall drive a motor vehicle so as to cause it to leave the premises of an establishment at which gasoline offered for retail sale was dispensed into the fuel tank of such motor vehicle unless the payment of authorized charge for the gasoline dispensed has been made.

(b) 
In addition to the penalties prescribed in paragraph (3)(a), every judgment of guilty of a petit theft for property described in this subsection shall provide for the suspension of the convicted person’s driver license. The court shall forward the driver license to the Department of Highway Safety and Motor Vehicles in accordance with s. 322.25.
1. 
The first suspension of a driver license under this subsection shall be for a period of up to 6 months.

2. 
The second or subsequent suspension of a driver license under this subsection shall be for a period of 1 year.

(6) 
A person who individually, or in concert with one or more other persons, coordinates the activities of one or more persons in committing theft under this section where the stolen property has a value in excess of $3,000 commits a felony of the second degree, punishable as provided in s. 775.082, s. 775.083, or s. 775.084.

(7) 
The Office of Program Policy Analysis and Government Accountability (OPPAGA) shall perform a study every 5 years to determine the appropriateness of the threshold amounts included in this section. The study’s scope must include, but need not be limited to, the crime trends related to theft offenses, the theft threshold amounts of other states in effect at the time of the study, the fiscal impact of any modifications to this state’s threshold amounts, and the effect on economic factors, such as inflation. The study must include options for amending the threshold amounts if the study finds that such amounts are inconsistent with current trends. In conducting the study, OPPAGA shall consult with the Office of Economic and Demographic Research in addition to other interested entities. OPPAGA shall submit a report to the Governor, the President of the Senate, and the Speaker of the House of Representatives by September 1 of every 5th year.

fl:statute:810.011.title: Definitions
fl:statute:810.011.text:
810.011 
Definitions.
—

As used in this chapter:
(1) 
“Structure” means a building of any kind, either temporary or permanent, which has a roof over it, together with the curtilage thereof. However, during the time of a state of emergency declared by executive order or proclamation of the Governor under chapter 252 and within the area covered by such executive order or proclamation and for purposes of ss. 810.02 and 810.08 only, the term means a building of any kind or such portions or remnants thereof as exist at the original site, regardless of absence of a wall or roof.

(2) 
“Dwelling” means a building or conveyance of any kind, including any attached porch, whether such building or conveyance is temporary or permanent, mobile or immobile, which has a roof over it and is designed to be occupied by people lodging therein at night, together with the curtilage thereof. However, during the time of a state of emergency declared by executive order or proclamation of the Governor under chapter 252 and within the area covered by such executive order or proclamation and for purposes of ss. 810.02 and 810.08 only, the term includes such portions or remnants thereof as exist at the original site, regardless of absence of a wall or roof.

(3) 
“Conveyance” means any motor vehicle, ship, vessel, railroad vehicle or car, trailer, aircraft, or sleeping car; and “to enter a conveyance” includes taking apart any portion of the conveyance. However, during the time of a state of emergency declared by executive order or proclamation of the Governor under chapter 252 and within the area covered by such executive order or proclamation and for purposes of ss. 810.02 and 810.08 only, the term “conveyance” means a motor vehicle, ship, vessel, railroad vehicle or car, trailer, aircraft, or sleeping car or such portions thereof as exist.

(4) 
An act is committed “in the course of committing” if it occurs in an attempt to commit the offense or in flight after the attempt or commission.

(5)(a) 
“Posted land” is land upon which any of the following are placed:
1. 
Signs placed not more than 500 feet apart along and at each corner of the boundaries of the land or, for land owned by a water control district that exists pursuant to chapter 298 or was created by special act of the Legislature, signs placed at or near the intersection of any district canal right-of-way and a road right-of-way or, for land classified as agricultural pursuant to s. 193.461, signs placed at each point of ingress and at each corner of the boundaries of the agricultural land, which prominently display in letters of not less than 2 inches in height the words “no trespassing” and the name of the owner, lessee, or occupant of the land. The signs must be placed along the boundary line of posted land in a manner and in such position as to be clearly noticeable from outside the boundary line; or

2.a. 
A conspicuous no trespassing notice is painted on trees or posts on the property, provided that the notice is:
(I) 
Painted in an international orange color and displaying the stenciled words “No Trespassing” in letters no less than 2 inches high and 1 inch wide either vertically or horizontally;

(II) 
Placed so that the bottom of the painted notice is not less than 3 feet from the ground or more than 5 feet from the ground; and

(III) 
Placed at locations that are readily visible to any person approaching the property and no more than 500 feet apart on agricultural land.

b. 
When a landowner uses the painted no trespassing posting to identify a no trespassing area, those painted notices must be accompanied by signs complying with subparagraph 1. and must be placed conspicuously at all places where entry to the property is normally expected or known to occur.

(b) 
It shall not be necessary to give notice by posting on any enclosed land or place not exceeding 5 acres in area on which there is a dwelling house in order to obtain the benefits of ss. 810.09 and 810.12 pertaining to trespass on enclosed lands.

(6) 
“Cultivated land” is that land which has been cleared of its natural vegetation and is presently planted with a crop, orchard, grove, pasture, or trees or is fallow land as part of a crop rotation.

(7) 
“Fenced land” is that land which has been enclosed by a fence of substantial construction, whether with rails, logs, post and railing, iron, steel, barbed wire, other wire, or other material, which stands at least 3 feet in height. For the purpose of this chapter, it shall not be necessary to fence any boundary or part of a boundary of any land which is formed by water.

(8) 
Where lands are posted, cultivated, or fenced as described herein, then said lands, for the purpose of this chapter, shall be considered as enclosed and posted.

(9) 
“Litter” means any garbage, rubbish, trash, refuse, debris, can, bottle, box, container, paper, tobacco product, tire, domestic or commercial appliance, mechanical equipment or part, building or construction material, tool, machinery, wood, motor vehicle or motor vehicle part, vessel, aircraft, or farm machinery or equipment; sludge from a waste treatment facility, water supply treatment plant, or air pollution control facility; or substance in any form resulting from domestic, industrial, commercial, mining, agricultural, or governmental operations.

(10) 
“Dump” means to dump, throw, discard, place, deposit, or dispose of any litter.

(11) 
“Commercial horticulture property” means any property that is cleared of its natural vegetation and is planted in commercially cultivated horticulture products that are planted, grown, or harvested. The term also includes property that is used for the commercial sale, use, or distribution of horticulture products.

(12) 
“Agricultural chemicals manufacturing facility” means any facility, and any properties or structures associated with the facility, used for the manufacture, processing, or storage of agricultural chemicals classified in Industry Group 287 contained in the Standard Industrial Classification Manual, 1987, as published by the Office of Management and Budget, Executive Office of the President.

(13) 
“Construction site” means any property upon which there is construction that is subject to building permit posting requirements.

History.
—
